entries.description: King Pasenadi and said to him
entries.subject: King Pasenadi

spans.text: Then Queen Mallikā approached King Pasenadi and said to him, “Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, mahārāja, “What do you think, Great King?
If she were to decay and perish, would sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress arise in you?”
“If she were to decay and perish, my life would fall apart.
If I were to decay and perish, would sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress arise in you?”
“If you were to decay and perish, my life would fall apart.
If these realms were to decay and perish, would sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress arise in you?”
